visual_identity.core_identity: A small, wiry goblinoid fighter who looks scrappy, sharp-featured, and dangerous rather than cute or heroic, relying on speed, dirty tricks, and scavenged gear.
visual_identity.silhouette: Small lean fighter with oversized pointed ears, bent knees, slightly hunched shoulders, narrow torso, and crude weapon kept close; sparse hair at most, never furry.
visual_identity.head_features: Oversized pointed ears, broad flattened nose, angular cheeks, low brow, sharp chin, wide mouth with irregular small teeth, intense crafty eyes; unmistakably goblin, not imp, elf, or orc.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact thin-limbed humanoid with sinewy arms and legs, quick hands and feet, agile crouched stance, and no bodybuilder mass.
visual_identity.surface: Bare or lightly scarred skin with sparse hair only; no fur covering or fluffy facial outline.
signature_gear: small shield or light scavenged armor

accuracy_checks: ears are clearly oversized and pointed
weapon and light armor read clearly

reference.notes: Reference guides goblin anatomy; Black-Ink style controls line art.
